{
  "id": "mpray2w1kj",
  "title": "Webapp: Improve layout navigation and responsiveness",
  "description": "## Context
The webapp layout and navigation need better visual hierarchy, responsive behavior, and information architecture. Users need clear wayfinding especially in detail views.

## Scope

### 1. Header component - Navigation Improvements
- Add clear visual hierarchy to navigation items
- Active page indicator (highlight current nav item)
- Improve spacing and alignment using design tokens
- Add hover states to navigation links
- Ensure navigation works on mobile (hamburger menu or sheet-based nav if not already)

### 2. AppLayout component - Page Structure
- Add consistent page title region at the top of each page
- Add breadcrumb navigation in detail views (e.g., Issues then Issue #123)
- Ensure consistent content width and max-width
- Proper padding using design token spacing values
- Consider a sidebar for navigation on desktop if it improves the layout

### 3. IssueDetailPage - Detail View Layout
- Add page title showing issue title prominently
- Add breadcrumb with Issues link then Issue title
- Improve section hierarchy (details, comments, blockages, sub-issues)
- Add clear visual separation between sections
- Make the layout work on smaller screens (stack columns)

### 4. Responsive Behavior
- Test and fix layouts at breakpoints: mobile (640px), tablet (768px), desktop (1024px and above)
- Issue list: stack columns on mobile
- Issue detail: single column on mobile, multi-column on desktop
- Forms: full-width on mobile, constrained on desktop
- Navigation: collapsible on mobile

## Files to Modify
- All files under packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/layout/
- packages/webapp/frontend/src/pages/IssueDetailPage.tsx
- packages/webapp/frontend/src/pages/IssuesPage.tsx
- packages/webapp/frontend/src/pages/UsersPage.tsx
- packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueList.tsx
- packages/webapp/frontend/src/components/issues/IssueRow.tsx

## Acceptance Criteria
- Header has clear active state for current page
- Detail views show breadcrumb navigation
- Page titles are prominent and consistent
- All pages render correctly at 640px, 768px, and 1024px and above widths
- No horizontal overflow on mobile
- Navigation is fully keyboard accessible
- Content has consistent padding and max-width

## Constraints
- Use design tokens for spacing, typography, colors
- Keep existing page functionality and routes intact
- Use shadcn/ui Sheet component for mobile nav if needed (already available)
- Do not introduce new routing or page structure changes",
